messages:
sam: Heads-up — starting edge rollout for v2 gateway lanes in 15m. Target lanes: edge-us-east-07, edge-us-west-03. Watch canary signals.

deploy-bot: deploybot: initiating staged rollout v2 -> gateway (lanes=2, steps=10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%). Runbook: /ops/runbooks/v2-rollout

mica: for clients with older SDKs we should keep header pin support. Please coordinate client pin header docs.

taylor: +1 on header. Can we add a temporary throttle at proxy level for tenant shims? worried about 5xx spike.

sam: adding throttle rule on the canary path: rate-limit 50r/s per tenant, burst 100. Will monitor latency and error-rate.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary step 1 complete. lane edge-us-east-07 at 10% traffic. no errors in 5m.

kevin: seeing minor increase in upstream timeouts (504) for a small subset: tenant abc-corp. Suggest pinning them to v1 via header.

sam: pinning in gateway config for abc-corp now. push to prod: header-based pin added. Example usage: 

```
curl -H "X-Redwood-Client-Pin: v1" https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate
```

mica: can we set rollback criteria now: if p95 latency > 800ms OR error-rate > 1% for 5m then pause and step back.

taylor: noted. also update release notes to call out "edge path changes" and the pin header. I'll open a docs PR.

deploy-bot: deploybot: step 2 started -> 30%. Observability: p50/p95 stable, error-rate 0.2%. No new alarms.

kevin: after pin, abc-corp error-rate back to baseline. good.

sam: holding at 30% for 10m and re-evaluating; if stable we go to 60%. tagging oncall for a 30-min watch: @taylor @kevin

uxa: marketing requests a short note about client migrations. They want timing decoupled from the rollout announcement.

mica: small regression spotted in tokenization for a subset of our model matrix (token boundaries drift). Low severity in prod tests but recorded in evals dashboard. If this surfaces in canary we should pause.

deploy-bot: deploybot: detected regression in evals-runner for model bert-large on step 3; triggering pause. auto-paused at 30%. rollback allowed: run command:

```
deploybot rollback --to v1-gateway --lanes edge-us-east-07,edge-us-west-03
```

sam: executing rollback now.

deploy-bot: deploybot: rollback started. Rolling back lanes. Expected completion ~2m.

deploy-bot: deploybot: rollback complete. lanes restored to v1. Canary aborted after step 2.

taylor: filing a short postmortem in release docs and adding pinning & tokenization test cases to the QA checklist.

sam: thanks all. Reopen change window once tokenization fix is validated and client-pin propagation is exercised. I'll start a new deploy thread when ready.
